data_description.ha_inform_rate: How often to update sensors in Home Assistant (2-600 seconds). Lower values = more responsive but higher system load and DB writes.
data_description.three_phase: Enable only if your service is 120/208V three-phase (common in apartments and condos with shared utility transformers). In this mode, two-pole breaker voltages are multiplied by √3/2 (~0.866) to report the correct 208V line-to-line voltage instead of the incorrect 240V. Do NOT enable for standard 120/240V single-phase residential service.
data_description.allow_breaker_control: When enabled, HA will create switch entities allowing you to trip/reset breakers. When disabled, breakers are only treated as sensors.
data_description.allow_led_blink: When enabled, HA will create a switch per breaker to blink its LED for physical identification. When disabled, no LED-control entities are created. Independent of Allow Breaker Control.
data_description.enable_decora: When enabled, LDATA will also discover and create entities for Decora Smart Wi-Fi switches, dimmers, fans, outlets, and GFCIs on your account. Leave disabled if you don't have any — it avoids extra API calls on every update.
data_description.show_sidebar_panel: Adds an item to the Home Assistant sidebar that opens a full-page, interactive view of your load center. If you have more than one LDATA entry, the same page shows the load centers of every entry that has this turned on.
data_description.gap_handling: Fallback for older firmware without hardware energy counters. How breaker daily energy sensors handle gaps when no data is received. Skip: safest. Extrapolate: assume last known power. Average: compromise. Panels with firmware 2.0+ use hardware counters and ignore this setting.
data_description.gap_threshold: Time without data before gap handling activates (1-30 minutes). Only applies to power×time fallback on older firmware.
data_description.log_warnings: Log integration crashes or web errors.
data_description.log_data_warnings: Log warnings of data inconsistencies from Leviton (spikes/resets).
data_description.log_all_raw: Log the raw WebSocket string as received from Leviton. Warning: output is unredacted and will contain auth tokens and device IDs. Disable when not actively debugging.
data_description.log_parsed_data: Log all breaker and panel fields after parsing each WebSocket or REST update. Useful for verifying values without enabling raw WebSocket logging.
data_description.enable_specific_logging: Log any specified field. Field names can be found by briefly enabling 'Log All Parsed Data'.
data_description.log_fields: To find field names, enable 'Log All Parsed Data' and check Home Assistant logs. Enter above as comma separated.

sub_panels.name: Sub-panels
sub_panels.description: If a load center is fed from a breaker in another one, choose that breaker next to its name. That breaker then shows the sub-panel's live load and leads to the sub-panel.

error.sub_panel_loop: Two load centers cannot feed each other. Check the choices under Sub-panels.

options.skip: Skip — Don't accumulate energy during gaps
options.extrapolate: Extrapolate — Assume last known power continued
options.average: Average — Use mean of last and recovery power

reset_energy_baseline.name: Reset energy sensor baseline
reset_energy_baseline.description: Reset a stuck LDATA energy sensor. Check the Home Assistant log for the current value before and after the reset. For lifetime sensors (consumption/import), the sensor will accept the next API reading. For daily sensors, baselines are cleared and the sensor re-establishes from the current API values.

entity_id.name: Entity
entity_id.description: The LDATA energy sensor to reset.

value.name: New value in kWh (optional)
value.description: Force a specific kWh value instead of using the current API reading. Leave blank to accept whatever the API reports on the next update.

baseline.name: Hardware Baseline in kWh (optional)
baseline.description: Manually set the raw hardware counter baseline used for delta calculations on daily sensors.

reset_panel_energy.name: Reset all panel energy sensors
reset_panel_energy.description: Reset all daily and lifetime energy sensors for a WHEM panel in one operation. Use this after a panel factory reset, when all hardware energy counters drop to zero simultaneously. All daily sensor baselines are cleared (daily totals restart from 0) and all lifetime sensor guards are released (each will accept the next API reading unconditionally). Select any device that belongs to the panel — the panel itself, a breaker, or a CT. Check the Home Assistant log for a per-sensor reset summary.

device_id.name: Panel device
device_id.description: Any device belonging to the WHEM panel — the panel, a breaker, or a CT. All energy sensors for the resolved panel will be reset.
